design_inputs.only: published per-stratum counts; no item-level journals or reserve items

candidate_rule.input: Existing family-B parsed records and exact queried entity/mass/mg; no normalization model, parser or prompt changes.
candidate_rule.filter: current=true AND exact entity AND measurement=mass AND unit=mg
candidate_rule.comparison: Exact Decimal equality of all matching values; no float tolerance, rounding, unit conversion or majority vote. Numeric equality already exists in the baseline; preserve it.
candidate_rule.disagreement: abstain if any matching numeric value differs, including a single dissenter
candidate_rule.agreement: Select lexicographically smallest full source_id among ALL matching agreeing records; emit that record identity, exact numeric value rendered as Decimal and unit. Do not ask the model to choose provenance.
candidate_rule.unsupported: fail closed under unchanged family-B parser/input bounds
candidate_rule.new_effect: Deterministic answer/source selection instead of model choice; not a novel numeric-equality implementation.
candidate_rule.implementation_status: specification frozen; candidate implementation and source hash required before admission

predictions.risk_primary: dissenter: accidental majority/approximate equality would hide a real conflict
risk_secondary: stale-vs-current: stale lexical winner must not be eligible
entity-decoy and measurement-decoy: source ordering must follow exact relevance filtering
predictions.expected_effect: Fewer provenance errors; no predicted gain from already-existing Decimal equality; no measured v5 result.

evaluation.mode: paired anytime-valid sequential reserve stream; NOT fixed-slice gate
evaluation.exclude: All consumed slice1 items and all development items
evaluation.schedule: Gate-private deterministic seeded shuffle within strata then stratified round-robin across pooled unused containers, full rounds before leftovers. Seed 20261017. Freeze schedule hash before first outcome; no candidate/designer item access.
evaluation.candidate_vs: retained family-B v4, paired on identical items
evaluation.gate_source_status: Existing v2 gate/contract is simulation-only and remains unchanged, unsigned, inactive. Future versioned reserve adapter required; no production deployment assertion.

proposed_gate.plateau: max(3, ceil(2 * stdev(three real dev seed deltas) * 200)); deltas not yet measured; do not invent zeros
proposed_gate.marginal_delta: paired v5 correctness minus v4 correctness with only the candidate change reverted

evaluation.wallet: Dedicated prospective research allocation required before access; existing simulation wallet is exhausted/immutable and must not be reused or reset. No alpha allocated by this registration.
stop_rules: domain violation or registered stratum veto: retain incumbent
E >= 4000 and plateau met and all strata observed: proposal only
evaluation.statistical_limit: Anytime-valid claim requires conditional null assumption and prospective without-replacement finite-bank validity review; absent review, exploratory only. Stratum veto non-crossing is not noninferiority proof.
admission_blockers: tested versioned reserve gate adapter and explicit research activation
three-seed dev deltas for plateau, without reserve access
exclusive unused-reserve proof and schedule commitment by gate custodian
dedicated alpha wallet commitment and statistical validity review
evaluation.call_budget: Candidate rule requires zero model calls on supported records; paired v4 <=200 logical model calls, <=600 physical attempts with two identical-request retries. Any later dev/calibration calls are separately registered; no such calls now.
